days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Genuinely relaxed: you could hold a full conversation.
days.extra: Strength maintenance (25 min): 2x5 at last heavy load, calf raises 2x12, pogo hops 2x15. Nothing to failure.

days.title: Half sharpener: 5 x 1km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 5 x 1km at half marathon pace, 90s jog. 3km cool down.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Add 4 x 20s strides at the end.

days.title: Easy + strides
days.detail: 50 min easy at {E}, then 6 x 20s strides.

days.title: Rest
days.detail: Rest day before the race weekend.

days.title: Shakeout
days.detail: 20 to 25 min very easy plus 4 strides.

days.title: HALF MARATHON RACE
days.detail: Tune-up race Sunday 21 March. 2km warm up. Target 1:23 to 1:24 (3:57/km). Run even. 2km cool down. Result resets your training VDOT.

w22.phaseNote: Convert speed into marathon endurance. Long runs carry big blocks at goal marathon pace. Half marathon tune-up 21 Mar. Taper from week 24.
w22.focus: Peak week. The 34km with 22km at pace is the session the whole plan builds to.

days.title: Rest
days.detail: Rest after Sunday's race. Easy swim or walk if you like.
days.extra: Strength maintenance (25 min): 2x5 at last heavy load, calf raises 2x12, pogo hops 2x15. Nothing to failure.

days.title: Midweek MP: 14km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 14km at {GMP}. 3km cool down.
days.extra: Strength B (35 min, after the session, same day): step-ups 3x8 each, single-leg RDL 3x8, straight-knee calf raise 3x12, pogo hops 3x20, bounding 3x30m, side plank 2x40s.

days.title: Easy (double)
days.detail: AM 10km easy at {E}. PM 6km very easy.

days.title: Marathon blend: 3 x 4km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 3 x 4km alternating 1km at {T} and 1km at {GMP}, 2 min jog. 2km cool down.

days.title: Easy + strides
days.detail: Short and easy, slower than {E}, then 4 x 15s strides. Sets the legs up for Saturday.

days.title: Long run: 22km MP
days.detail: 12km at {E}, then 22km at {GMP}. Full race-day fuelling rehearsal. This is the key run of the block.

days.title: Day off
days.detail: No running. Optional: 30 to 45 min easy swim or a walk. Recharge for the week.

w23.phaseNote: Convert speed into marathon endurance. Long runs carry big blocks at goal marathon pace. Half marathon tune-up 21 Mar. Taper from week 24.
w23.focus: Last big week. Full dress rehearsal Saturday.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Genuinely relaxed: you could hold a full conversation.
days.extra: Strength A (45 min, after run): trap-bar deadlift or back squat 3x5 heavy, Bulgarian split squat 3x6 each, single-leg soleus raise (bent knee) 3x12 heavy, Nordic hamstring 3x5, Copenhagen plank 3x20s each side.

days.title: Midweek MP: 12km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 12km at {GMP}. 3km cool down.
days.extra: Strength B (35 min, after the session, same day): step-ups 3x8 each, single-leg RDL 3x8, straight-knee calf raise 3x12, pogo hops 3x20, bounding 3x30m, side plank 2x40s.

days.title: Easy (double)
days.detail: AM 9km easy at {E}. PM 6km very easy.

days.title: Threshold: 4 x 2km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 4 x 2km at {T}, 90s jog. 2km cool down.

days.title: Easy + strides
days.detail: Short and easy, slower than {E}, then 4 x 15s strides. Sets the legs up for Saturday.

days.title: Long run: 16km MP
days.detail: 12km at {E}, then 16km at {GMP}. Race shoes, race kit, race breakfast.

days.title: Day off
days.detail: No running. Optional: 30 to 45 min easy swim or a walk. Recharge for the week.

w24.phaseNote: Convert speed into marathon endurance. Long runs carry big blocks at goal marathon pace. Half marathon tune-up 21 Mar. Taper from week 24.
w24.focus: Taper: volume down about 30%, intensity stays. Trust it.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Genuinely relaxed: you could hold a full conversation.
days.extra: Strength maintenance (25 min): 2x5 at last heavy load, calf raises 2x12, pogo hops 2x15. Nothing to failure.

days.title: MP: 8km
days.detail: 2km warm up. 8km at {GMP}. 2km cool down.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Add 4 x 20s strides at the end.

days.title: Taper: 6 x 1km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 6 x 1km at {T}, 1 min jog. 2km cool down.

days.title: Easy + strides
days.detail: Short and easy, slower than {E}, then 4 x 15s strides. Sets the legs up for Saturday.

days.title: Long run: 10km MP
days.detail: 11km at {E}, then 10km at {GMP}.

days.title: Day off
days.detail: No running. Optional: 30 to 45 min easy swim or a walk. Recharge for the week.

w25.focus: Race week. Freshness and carbohydrate are all that matter now.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}. Start carb loading Thursday, not now.

days.title: MP: 3 x 2km
days.detail: 3km warm up. 3 x 2km at {GMP}, 2 min jog. 3km cool down. Last real session.

days.title: Easy
days.detail: Easy at {E}.

days.title: Easy + MP touches
days.detail: 5km easy with 4 x 1 min at {GMP}. Carb load begins: 8 to 10 g carbs per kg body weight per day, Thu to Sat.

days.title: Rest
days.detail: Rest. Carb load. Travel to Ballarat if staying over.

days.title: Shakeout
days.detail: 20 min very easy plus 4 strides. Lay out kit, gels, breakfast. Carb load day 3.

days.title: BALLARAT MARATHON
days.detail: 8:00am start, Ballarat Town Hall. Breakfast 3 hours before (2 to 3 g carbs per kg). First 5km at goal pace plus 5s, then lock onto {GMP}. 80 to 90g carbs per hour from 30 min. Race from 32km.
